receipt.limitations: Actual built H5/createApp/JWT/owned PG16; accepted carousel/catalogue GETs use real controllers and full 50-table/46-sequence snapshots. Catalogue inserts/sort setup and two initial real Admin-controller saves are separate setup; runtime two schema saves and station close/open are the only allowed configuration writes. The fixture-only Admin host proves parser/controller/transaction, not production Admin authentication or ACL. PHP Admin devise/index.vue permits only one home_comb, excludes search/tabNav and inserts it first; two imported homeComb instances intentionally stress existing TS multi-instance behavior, not a claim that the PHP editor creates this configuration. Synthetic unrelated chrome, registered article-list destination and missing-table hot-keyword destination chrome are explicitly tagged, with no article-detail/visit/like acceptance. Exact legacy homepage page=1/limit=8 recommendations use real products SQL and are distinguished from scoped category reads. Search destination proves encoded searchVal route/input only: keyword-only products request is attempted through real API and its actual error is preserved because owned user_search is absent; search results/history persistence are unverified and search GET is not claimed read-only. Root footer is never adopted from selected body; original micro caller footer remains through all body selections. Internal HTTPS Request on HTTP loopback is a transport bridge, not TLS acceptance. No automatic poster, album, cart or provider operation is exercised. Long-lived lease renewal uses separate Node fake-clock proofs; Browser proves fresh schema reads/tickets after real configuration save. H5 autoplay is accepted; IAB does not support native touch gesture injection and manual swipe is not claimed. No MP/App device, real provider, production, Windows or standalone PHP execution acceptance.
